title: Fahrenheit: Indigo Prophecy Remastered
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#700, 2026-10-26), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, in a Steam library on an external drive (its own, not the Mac Steam's): does not launch in DXMT, DXVK or D3DMetal. The DXMT and DXVK logs show Fahrenheit.exe failing to load its own DLLs (Qt5, SDL2, libgcc_s_dw2-1, libstdc++-6), which were not beside it. The reporter then found them in a Fahrenheit.exe.local folder next to the exe, Windows' DLL redirection, which Wine's loader does not look in; with the DLLs linked next to the exe the game reached gameplay, needing Emulate display mode changes to keep its resolution and a DirectX 9 warning dismissed. Not verified by the maintainer. Later the same day the reporter played it through the tutorial with a working setup: In a Window in the pre-launch settings, the keyboard to get through login and enable the gamepad in Options, Controls, and Steam Input on for a DualSense. udance4ever again on highball-db#700 (2026-11-07), the Wine 11 engine r30: with the linked DLLs removed the game starts, so r30 reads the Fahrenheit.exe.local folder. In a Window in the pre-launch settings is still needed. On the splash screen only click the window's title bar and press Enter, a click in the picture zooms it in. From the profile screen on the mouse works, it no longer sticks to the screen's edge. The picture is slightly cropped on the right, which didn't get in the way in the tutorial. A DualSense works with Steam Input on.
notes: Playable with workarounds for the one report so far (M1). On the Wine 11 engine r30 or r31 it starts as it is, since those engines read the Fahrenheit.exe.local folder. On other engines link the DLLs from Fahrenheit.exe.local next to Fahrenheit.exe first (Wine's loader there does not search that folder). Choose In a Window in the pre-launch settings: fullscreen breaks on the first menu click. On the splash screen click the window's title bar and press Enter rather than clicking the picture, which zooms it in. On r30 the mouse works from the profile screen on; on the default engine it stays stuck at the screen's edge, so play there with the keyboard and a gamepad (enable it in Options, Controls). A DualSense needs Steam Input on, or the right stick does nothing. Steam's Mac version is 32-bit and no longer runs on macOS, so Highball installs the Windows one. Nothing was measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: The game stops before opening a window in every graphics mode, its own DLLs not found
knownIssues.cause: the DLLs sit in Fahrenheit.exe.local, Windows' DLL redirection folder, which Wine's loader does not search (also missing upstream, checked 2026-10-26)
knownIssues.fix: the Wine 11 engines r30 and r31 (Highball 0.10.26) look in a program's .local folder, confirmed with this game on r30 (highball-db#700, 2026-11-07, credit udance4ever). On other engines link each DLL from Fahrenheit.exe.local next to Fahrenheit.exe by hand (for x in Fahrenheit.exe.local/*.dll; do ln -s "$x" .; done in the game folder)

knownIssues.symptom: The first menu click switches the game to 1024x768 and then it fails with 'A DirectX 9.0c or higher compliant video card is needed' or 'D3D ERROR! Fail to create texture surface' (an M1, DXVK's Direct3D 9, highball-db#700)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed: opening a menu makes the game rebuild its Direct3D 9 device for its own fullscreen mode, and the device or its textures fail to create. In a window instead, the mouse sticks to the screen's right edge
knownIssues.fix: none confirmed. Emulate display mode changes got the reporter in once, not reliably

knownIssues.symptom: A DirectX 9 warning dialog at start
knownIssues.fix: dismiss it, the game goes on

knownIssues.symptom: In a window the mouse cursor sticks to the screen's edge and the mouse cannot be used (the default Wine 10 engine)
knownIssues.fix: on the Wine 11 engine r30 the mouse works from the profile screen on (highball-db#700, 2026-11-07). On the default engine play with the keyboard and a gamepad: enable the gamepad in Options, Controls with the arrow keys

knownIssues.symptom: A DualSense's right stick does nothing
knownIssues.cause: the game reads the pad through XInput
knownIssues.fix: turn Steam Input on for the game. The XInputPlus route on PCGamingWiki did not help the reporter

knownIssues.symptom: In a window, a click in the picture on the splash screen zooms it in (M1, Wine 11 r30)
knownIssues.fix: click only the window's title bar, then press Enter to go on (highball-db#700, credit udance4ever)

knownIssues.symptom: The picture is slightly cropped on the right (M1, Wine 11 r30, in a window)
knownIssues.fix: none known, it didn't get in the way in the tutorial
